diagnosis: The procedure is protected by authentication (protectedProcedure) and validates input with Zod, but queries the file strictly by its UUID without checking where: { id: input.fileId, ownerId: ctx.user.id }. Any authenticated user can inspect private file metadata, S3 storage keys, and file sizes across accounts.
